items.title: Armand Hug Interview, 1960-07-14
items.q: Horace Dias was a very fine musician and a good piano player and a very good arranger.

ctx.x: Vic played around with bands, and in fact I think he played with Johnny Detroit if I'm not mistaken. And he used to do a lot of early radio work, solo work. Vic Pellegrini was a very, very fine jazz piano player. I would definitely tell him as a jazz piano player.
Horace Dias was a very fine musician and a good piano player and a very good arranger. In fact, I think he's still doing a lot of arranging work for some very fine bands right now.
